CMOS hysteretic under-voltage lockout
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 PWL(0 2.1 60u 3.6 90u 3.6 150u 2.1 180u 2.1 240u 3.6)
VREF vref 0 1.0
VB vb 0 .9
XDUT vdd 0 vref vb en astra_086_cmos_hysteretic_undervoltage_lockout
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec rising range 2.9 3.1 unit=V
* @spec falling range 2.4 2.65 unit=V
* @spec rising2 range 2.9 3.1 unit=V
* @spec off1 range 0 0.01 unit=dimensionless
* @spec on1 range 0.99 1.01 unit=dimensionless
* @spec off2 range 0 0.01 unit=dimensionless
* @spec on2 range 0.99 1.01 unit=dimensionless
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 5n 240u
let enabled=v(en)/v(vdd)
meas tran rising FIND v(vdd) WHEN enabled=.5 RISE=1
meas tran falling FIND v(vdd) WHEN enabled=.5 FALL=1
meas tran rising2 FIND v(vdd) WHEN enabled=.5 RISE=2
meas tran off1 FIND enabled AT=20u
meas tran on1 FIND enabled AT=80u
meas tran off2 FIND enabled AT=170u
meas tran on2 FIND enabled AT=235u
write out.raw v(en) v(vdd) v(xdut.sense)
quit
.endc
.end
